actions.name: classify_document
actions.title: Classify a document using IDP by Workato
actions.description: Classify a document using IDP by Workato
actions.help: This action classifies the content of a document based on the provided guidelines. Supported formats: png, jpg, webp, gif, pdf . v4 supports up to 50 pages and 50 MB. Other versions support up to 15 pages.

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: Provide the file name with file extension or specify the type in File type .

input.name: file_type
input.label: File type
input.hint: Select the file type of the file contents. Overrides the inferred type from File name .

input.name: idp_version
input.label: IDP version
input.hint: New versions are released regularly. Recipe will use selected version until manually updated.

input.name: classify_text
input.label: List of categories
input.hint: Create a list of categories to sort the text into. Rules are used to provide additional details to help classify what each category represents.

actions.name: process_document
actions.title: Process a document using IDP by Workato
actions.description: Process a document using IDP by Workato
actions.help: This action processes a file contents to find specific information based on defined guidelines. The processed information is then available as datapills. Supported formats: png, jpg, webp, gif, pdf . v4 supports up to 50 pages and 50 MB. Other versions support up to 15 pages.

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: Provide the file name with file extension or specify the type in File type .

input.name: file_type
input.label: File type
input.hint: Select the file type of the file contents. Overrides the inferred type from File name .

input.name: idp_version
input.label: IDP version
input.hint: New versions are released regularly. Recipe will use selected version until manually updated.

input.name: document_type
input.label: Document type
input.hint: Select the document type of the file.

input.name: document_description
input.label: Document description
input.hint: Include details relevant to the document such as language, location of certain fields, etc.
